description_expanded: SummaryNestled along the shores of coastal dune Oyster Lake, our Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental provides a majestic retreat for your next getaway. Our property boasts 8 spacious bedrooms and a private pool, ensuring comfort for up to 24 guests, including a private carriage house with a separate kitchen for added privacy. Enjoy mornings on the dock, golf cart rides to town or a short walk or to the sand, just 9 minutes away. Experience the best of the pool, lake, and beach at this luxe estate.SpaceStep inside this expansive 4,840-square-foot lakefront estate, where modern luxury meets coastal comfort. The main house features an open-concept living area anchored by a massive 85" Smart TV and a gourmet chef’s kitchen. This well-stocked kitchen is equipped with high-end finishes, a Keurig, a drip coffee maker, and a toaster oven, perfect for preparing large family feasts. With multiple king suites and a massive third-floor bunk room that can sleep a crowd, our property is designed for privacy and ease. For added flexibility, the carriage house serves as a self-contained retreat, featuring two private bedrooms and its own full kitchen, making it ideal for separate families or groups traveling together. The outdoor living space is a private oasis designed for ultimate relaxation and recreation. Transition seamlessly from the house to the sun-drenched patio, where you’ll find a private pool and a hot tub overlooking the serene waters of Oyster Lake. Whether you are taking a refreshing dip or soaking in the spa at sunset, the views of the coastal dune lake provide a breathtaking backdrop. The estate also includes a private wooden dock, offering a peaceful spot for morning coffee or direct water access for a day of lakefront fun. Adventure is at your fingertips with a premium collection of amenities included with your stay. Explore the calm waters of Oyster Lake using the provided kayaks and paddleboards, or take the 6-person golf cart for a quick spin or walk (9 minutes) to the Gulf’s sugar-white sands. If you prefer to travel on two wheels, hop on the provided bikes to cruise the scenic 30A corridor. After a day of exploring Dune Allen and the surrounding beach communities, return to our property and enjoy the convenience of on-site parking for up to 8 vehicles in the large private driveway. Location perks: Oyster Lake (on-site), Oyster Bay (on-site),West Allen Loop Beach Access, (0.5 miles), Fort Panic Beach Access (0.7 miles), Dune Allen Regional Beach Access (0.9 Miles), Stallworth Beach Access (1.4 miles) Interior — Kitchen (drip coffee maker, Keurig, blender, kettle, toaster oven, cooking utensils, tableware) — 7 Smart TVs (85" in the living room) — Game room with pool and ping pong table — Desk/Monitor work space — In-unit laundry room — Free WiFi (500 Mbps) — Central heat and A/C — 4,840 sq. ft. Exterior — Private pool (heating cost is $100/day by request) — Private in-pool hot tub — Private wooden dock — 6 seat golf cart — 6 bikes — Paddle boards and kayaks for the lake — On-site parking for 8 vehicles in the driveway (no garage access) Floor Configuration Main Floor - Bedroom 1: King bed (inferred) with en-suite bathroom (walk-in shower), living room, kitchen, dining area Middle Floor (Second Floor) - Bedroom 2 (Master): King bed with en-suite bathroom (walk-in rain shower), Bedroom 3: King bed with Jack and Jill bathroom access, Bedroom 4: King bed with Jack and Jill bathroom access, Bedroom 5: King bed with en-suite bathroom, Lap-top friendly work space, Laundry room Top Floor - Bedroom 6 (Bunk Room): 2 Bunk beds (twin over full and full over full), 2 full beds and 1 twin with bathroom access, game room, wet bar with mini fridge, patio access Cottage House - Bedroom 7: Queen bed, Bedroom 8: 2 twin beds, full kitchen, shared full bathroom NeighborhoodLocated in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach, this neighborhood offers a tranquil coastal vibe centered around the natural beauty of Oyster Lake and the Gulf of Mexico. The area is renowned for its sugar-white sand beaches and rare coastal dune lakes. Guests can enjoy a variety of activities including paddleboarding on the lake, cycling along the scenic 30A corridor, or exploring local boutique shops and upscale dining in nearby seaside communities. TransitA car is recommended to fully enjoy the attractions and beaches along the 30A corridor. Guests will have access to 6 bikes and a 6-seat golf cart. Our property offers significant on-site parking with space for up to 8 vehicles in the private driveway. AccessGuests have exclusive access to the entire 8-bedroom estate, including the main house and the carriage house suite with the exception of the garage. This access includes the private pool, the in-pool hot tub, and the private wooden dock. On-site parking for up to 8 vehicles is available in the private driveway. NotesPlease note that the pool and hot tub are serviced between guests. Please note that the garage is not accessible.House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees to follow all local, state and federal level mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19. Violations that result in fines based on Guests' actions will be passed on to the Guest. 19. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 20. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 21. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. 22. Guest are liable for Golf Cart and Bike damageRead Less
